status: Frozen locally before real-sequence tracker runs, not independent preregistration

source_terms.license: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; original-source conditions may also apply
source_terms.scope: Local non-commercial research only; source media/GT/raw traces not redistributed
source_terms.attribution: MOTChallenge / Milan, Leal-Taixe, Reid, Roth and Schindler; MOT16 benchmark (arXiv:1603.00831)

selection: Previously studied diagnostic scenes, not independent or held-out. Fresh shared 8.4.176 CPU detector caches; old 8.4.115 scores are not controls.
order: Rotate configuration order by trial, seed OpenCV 0, one OpenCV thread

interventions.confirmation: Upstream minimum_consecutive_frames=2/3/5 only; ByteTrack consecutive-success counter vs BoT-SORT successful-update counter. BoT-SORT instant-first-frame exception kept.
interventions.competition: At birth hook only, veto unmatched high-confidence new tracks with bbox IoU >=.5 to a confirmed retained track after current CMC/association. Use no GT. Already matched/weak association and output boxes stay upstream.
interventions.unchanged: Split .6, activation .3 except factory reference .7, buffer 30 (one second at reference FPS), source FPS, CMC and association costs; no ReID, weak-input filtering, worker or app default change

evaluation.official: Clean TrackEval 12c8791b303e0a0b50f753af204249e622d0281a; MOT17 distractor preprocessing, CLEAR IoU .5, Identity, HOTA
evaluation.paired_errors: After exact CLEAR reconciliation: added/removed FP at (frame, immutable cache detection index), FN/IDSW at (frame, GT). Never compare tracker IDs across runs.
evaluation.comparisons: Each candidate vs activation_control in same backend; combined arm also vs confirm3. Whole-sequence, per-sequence and event endpoint counts.
evaluation.screen: Research non-regression screen, not release acceptance: no per-sequence FN/FP/IDSW increase, no combined IDF1/HOTA decrease, and at least one combined FP or IDSW decrease vs activation_control. Report failed conditions, do not retune or change defaults.
evaluation.timing: Per-update direct-library association only; excludes detector, decode and startup; no worker IPC or real-time claim

limitations: Exploratory training-scene ablation; independent sequences, localisation/recovery isolation and general long-occlusion acceptance remain open.
Detector layer 8.4.176 reuses existing CUDA-capable application environment for CPU YOLO; not a fresh install of the complete Alpha.2 recipe.
IoU birth veto can suppress nearby real people; longer confirmation can add FN. Neither guarantees correct person identity.
No real RTSP, Windows pretrained/worker integration, 3D accuracy, endurance or throughput acceptance.
public_scope: Reviewed aggregate metrics, configuration/source hashes and attributed plot only. No media, GT, event windows, per-frame IDs, notes, raw traces or local paths.
